description: Every public dataset on this server: what it covers, its version, DOI, license (CC BY 4.0), credit line, last-checked date, the page to cite, its files and its tools.
name: list_datasets

meta.description: Credit line (attribution), citation, DOI, version, license (CC BY 4.0), disclaimer, notice and the page to cite

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page; null on the last page

dateChecked.description: YYYY-MM-DD the record was last checked against its source

line.description: The same facts as one sentence, to quote under an answer

retrievedAt.description: ISO 8601 time this answer was served

source.description: The original source: statute, rule, bar opinion, court report, agency table or platform policy

status.description: P primary source, S secondary, D default (no specific rule found), U open question
